name: Acapulco
description: In 1984, Maximo Gallardo's dream comes true when he gets the job of a lifetime at Acapulco's hottest resort, Las Colinas. But he soon realizes that working there will be far more complicated than he ever imagined.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: When he's hired at Acapulco's hottest resort, Maximo thinks he's scored his dream job—but quickly learns there's more to it than he thought.

videos.title: Jessie's Girl
videos.overview: Maximo strives to master the art of the upsell while attempting to help a wealthy young man propose to his girlfriend.

videos.title: Invisible Touch
videos.overview: Don Pablo teaches Maximo how to become an elite waiter so he can work an important dinner. Julia tries to impress a fashion editor.

videos.title: Crazy Little Thing Called Love
videos.overview: A pop superstar staying at the resort takes an interest in Julia, which concerns Maximo. Nora goes on her first date in a long time.

videos.title: All Night Long
videos.overview: Maximo and Chad go on an all-night journey outside the resort, while the staff must come together for a never-ending wedding reception.

videos.title: Uptown Girl
videos.overview: Maximo has a magical dream date with an American tourist. Memo bonds with his coworkers over a soccer match.

videos.title: For Your Eyes Only
videos.overview: When he learns that an eye doctor is staying at the resort, Maximo sneaks Nora in for the day. Diane discovers problems with the hotel.

videos.title: Time After Time
videos.overview: As Diane shows a group of journalists a photo exhibit of Las Colinas' history, the story of Don Pablo's long tenure at the resort is revealed.

videos.title: The Most Wonderful Time of the Year
videos.overview: Chaos erupts at the Christmas staff dinner when Maximo and Memo's plans backfire. Julia pieces together the truth behind her birthday gift.

videos.title: You Should Hear How She Talks About You
videos.overview: Las Colinas hosts a big New Year's Eve bash. Maximo tries to dazzle Diane so he'll earn a promotion. Chad makes a bold gesture.

videos.title: Break My Stride
videos.overview: Maximo is determined to start the new year with a clean slate. Julia struggles with Chad's surprise proposal.

videos.title: Hit Me with Your Best Shot
videos.overview: Desperate to pay off his family's debt, Maximo seizes an opportunity to wait on rival tennis stars. Diane tries to derail Julia and Chad's nuptials.

videos.title: Glory Days
videos.overview: Maximo gets swept up in a busy night with Isabel‘s family. Chad's fraternity brothers surprise him.

videos.title: Love Is a Battlefield
videos.overview: On Valentine‘s Day, Maximo and Julia have to decorate a romantic suite together. Memo and Lorena beg Lupe to let them spend time alone.

videos.title: We Don't Need Another Hero
videos.overview: Maximo takes Memo to a club to find his favorite soccer star. Sara spends an eventful night at Las Colinas.

videos.title: Hollywood Nights
videos.overview: Diane‘s past catches up with her as Las Colinas hosts the wrap party for a big Hollywood movie. Maximo faces a moral dilemma.

videos.title: Always Something There to Remind Me
videos.overview: Chaos ensues on the night of Chad and Julia's joint bachelor and bachelorette party.

videos.title: Money Changes Everything
videos.overview: Maximo is tasked with taking care of a billionaire investor. Chad and Julia discover a secret about Diane.

videos.title: The Power of Love
videos.overview: Maximo doubles down on his new life with Isabel. Sara receives a potentially life-changing offer.

videos.title: Against All Odds
videos.overview: Maximo gets a second chance at Las Colinas. Julia learns to go after what she wants.

videos.title: Just the Two of Us
videos.overview: Maximo learns a hard lesson of how to balance being a manager and friend to the staff at Las Colinas.

videos.title: Mamma Mia
videos.overview: On Mother's Day, Maximo wrestles with an opportunity to get closer to Diane despite his promise to spend the day with his mom.

videos.title: Dead Man's Party
videos.overview: Don Pablo comes to Maximo with a task that puts his training to the test. Julia faces a tough decision over whether to be honest with Nora.

videos.title: Private Dancer
videos.overview: In an attempt to relieve Julia's work stress, Maximo invites her to dinner. Esteban realizes Sara has a hidden talent. Nora makes a big step.

videos.title: Sweet Dreams Are Made of This
videos.overview: At Julia's long-anticipated dress shop opening, Maximo surprises her with a gift that goes wrong. Sara runs into her new crush.

videos.title: Take a Chance on Me
videos.overview: Present-day Maximo reconnects with Hector, whose arrival sparks a memory from 1985 that they each recall very differently.

videos.title: Video Killed the Radio Star
videos.overview: Memo and Maximo have a conflict over Memo's sister. Sara, Esteban, and Nora head to the big debate competition.

videos.title: Amor Eterno
videos.overview: On Día de Muertos, Don Pablo assigns Maximo a task that forces him to decide if he has what it takes to become the boss.

videos.title: Rock You Like a Hurricane
videos.overview: Las Colinas faces a looming hurricane. While Maximo reconciles with Julia, he makes a crucial mistake in his power struggle with Memo's sister.

videos.title: Burning Down the House
videos.overview: In 1985, Maximo makes a last-ditch effort to undo his mistake and protect Las Colinas. Present-day Maximo makes a massive decision.

videos.title: Waterfalls
videos.overview: As Maximo prepares for the hotel reopening, he recounts his first challenge as head of operations. In 1986, Memo and Lorena brace for parenthood.

videos.title: Rome, If You Want To
videos.overview: When harsh new rules are imposed on the staff, Maximo and Chad each try to address the tension. Esteban and Nora investigate a neighbor's death.

videos.title: Talkin' Bout a Revolution
videos.overview: Maximo learns about the challenges that come with leading an organized labor action. Diane uses a staff shortage to rattle Vera.

videos.title: Higher Love
videos.overview: During a research trip, Maximo musters up the courage to ask Julia a big question. Esteban and Nora's investigation takes a surprising turn.

videos.title: In the Air Tonight
videos.overview: Maximo invites Don Pablo to a family dinner in hopes of reconciling. Sara debates her college acceptance. Julia and Nora clash.

videos.title: Eso Me Enseño Mama
videos.overview: To console Sara, Maximo shares a childhood story about Nora navigating adversity.

videos.title: The Heat Is On
videos.overview: Present-day Maximo faces an unexpected rival for Julia's attention. In 1986, he goes head-to-head with Don Pablo to reclaim Las Colinas' glory.

videos.title: Runnin' Down a Dream
videos.overview: Maximo surprises Julia, Memo, and Lorena with a road trip to the World Cup. Sara struggles to practice her English before leaving for college.

videos.title: The Winner Takes It All
videos.overview: Complications during the Miss Universe Pageant force Maximo to take desperate measures to protect Las Colinas' reputation.

videos.title: Never Gonna Give You Up
videos.overview: On the day of the reopening, present-day Maximo makes one last effort with Julia—while in 1986, he plans to propose.
